posts.title: The River Remembers Everything
posts.description: © Julien Coquentin * Toni Morrison writes, All water has a perfect memory and is forever trying to get back to where it was. Back to the body of earth, of flesh, back to the mouth, the throat, back to the womb, back to the heart, its blood, back to our grief, back back back to when we were more than we have lately become.
